name: Clariburnus Tanthul

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Benighted Presence
traits.details: Bright light in the aura is reduced to dim light.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: Clariburnus regains 15 hit points whenever he starts his turn and has at least 1 hit point. When he takes radiant damage, his regeneration does not function on his next turn.

auras.name: Benighted Presence
auras.details: Bright light in the aura is reduced to dim light.

effect.description: Clariburnus uses gloom crescent twice (or three times while he is bloodied). He teleports up to 5 squares before each attack. If he hits the same target twice, that target takes ongoing 5 force damage (save ends).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target instead takes ongoing 10 force damage and is blinded (save ends both).

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is removed from play (save ends).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

effect.description: Clariburnus teleports up to 5 squares, or 10 squares if he ends the move in darkness.
